code: const t0=Date.now(); let r={}; try { await Word.run(async (c) => { const ps=c.document.pageSetup; ps.load("leftMargin,paperSize"); await c.sync(); r.read={l:ps.leftMargin,p:ps.paperSize,ms:Date.now()-t0}; }); } catch(e){ r.readErr=String(e&&e.message||e); } try { await Promise.race([Word.run(async (c) => { c.document.pageSetup.set({leftMargin:108}); await c.sync(); r.set="ok "+(Date.now()-t0); }), new Promise((_,rej)=>setTimeout(()=>rej(new Error("timeout 8s")),8000))]); } catch(e){ r.setErr=String(e&&e.message||e); } return r;
